_comment: Analysis definitions frozen BEFORE the main results were computed (see NOTES.md, 'Freeze'). Changing anything here after the freeze is a deviation and must be logged in NOTES.md with the pre-change values.

measures.R0: episodes ending with zero consultations / all episodes (outcome-agnostic)
measures.R1: resolved episodes with zero consultations / resolved episodes (numerator restricted to resolved as well; before 2026-09-28 review the wording was ambiguous, see NOTES.md Deviations 6)
measures.R0_prime: resolved episodes with zero consultations / all episodes (outcome-requiring)
measures.numerator_effect: R0 - R0_prime = share of all episodes that ended unresolved AND without consultation
measures.denominator_only_effect: R0_prime - R1 (same numerator; denominator all -> resolved)
measures.conditioning_effect: R0 - R1 = numerator_effect + denominator_only_effect (was 'denominator_effect' before 2026-09-28 review; see NOTES.md Deviations)

d1.label: Alaboudi & LaToza live-stream debugging episodes (public coding shared by the arXiv v1 and EMSE 2023 packages)

episode.merge_resumed_blocks: a block whose start code is DF7 continues the most recent episode that ended with DF4, within the same session

definitions.u: strict OR (title == 'Others' AND description has a U code)
definitions.ot2: strict OR (title == 'Others' AND description has OT2 = issue tracker)
definitions.ot2u: strict OR (title == 'Others' AND description has OT2 or a U code)

consultation.rationale: strict was fixed on 2026-09-06 by matching three independent statistics of the v1 paper (Table 4/5). The other three were added on 2026-09-28 because the EMSE 2023 version defines 'Consult resources' to include the issue tracker; their R values were seen once while identifying that rule (disclosed in NOTES.md). All four are reported.

d1.cluster: developer = project (githubURL); the EMSE 2023 paper (Table 2) maps the 15 videos to 11 developers on 11 projects
d1.strata: origin: committed (first block has DF8) vs fresh (otherwise)

reproduce_emse2023._note: Reported figures of the EMSE 2023 version, checked against the same public data under each consultation definition. NOT a gate: mismatches are results.

episodes_with_consult.quote: occurring in only 33% of debugging episodes

committed_with_consult.quote: Consulting resources occurred in all committed debugging episodes

fresh_with_consult.quote: but only 15% of fresh debugging episodes

developers_with_consult.quote: 91% of developers consulted external resources at least once

short_with_consult.quote: Developers did not consult resources in any of the short episodes

long_with_consult.quote: Consulting resources occurred during 74% of long episodes

time_share_top23.quote: 79% of the total episodes' time stemming from 23 episodes

d2.label: Li & Coblenz FSE 2026 debugging tasks (paper tables only; CC BY 4.0)

definitions.table5: task listed in Table 5 under documentation OR social-technical sources OR web sources
definitions.table5_plus_text: table5 OR task named in data/li-coblenz-2026/text_external.csv (body text describes consulting people/issue reports during that task; the paper states screen actions such as search were not coded at a fine grain)

participant_minutes._source: Sec. 4: 'seven participants (P1-P7) working on 11 debugging tasks totaling 7.8 hours'

streamer_hours._source: Sec. 4: 'five streamers (S1-S5) who worked on six debugging tasks over 3.1 hours' (compared with the Table 4 sum; not a gate)
